name: @untch/design-tokens
description: Untch design tokens (visual foundation). The single source of truth for colors, typography scale, spacing, radii, and shadows, adopted from the Impilo style reference and reconciled per internal/untch-design-reference.md §4b/§4c. Exports a typed manifest (src) and a generated Tailwind v4 @theme block (theme.css). No components; tokens only.
